title: Resisting Gone Wrong: Kids Cry as She Calls 911 - Mom’s Traffic Stop Escalates!
description:
On November 26th, 2023, an officer in Ohio observed a vehicle reversing in the middle of a road, then heading east while the driver appeared to be using a cell phone. The vehicle changed lanes without signaling and was clocked at 46 mph in a 35 mph zone. After initiating a traffic stop, the officer approached the driver, who was holding a cell phone and refused to comply with requests for her driver's license. The driver began recording the officer, asked for a chief to respond, and continued to refuse to provide identification.

Despite multiple orders to exit the vehicle, the driver refused and called 911 to request the presence of the chief and sheriff. Additional officers arrived on the scene, and after repeated warnings, the officers informed the driver that she was under arrest for obstructing official business. They then physically removed her from the vehicle and placed her in handcuffs. The driver requested medical attention for minor injuries and was transported to a hospital while refusing to cooperate further with the officers. The suspect had her two children in the backseat, who were later released into a family member’s custody.

During the vehicle's impoundment, officers found a loaded firearm in the glovebox. The weapon was secured for safekeeping. The suspect was charged with Obstructing Official Business and was issued citations for Operating a Motor Vehicle Without a Valid License, Signals Before Changing, and Speeding.
